ru.title: Зачем клясться? | Иисус Христос (Матфей 5:34-36)
ru.description:
Почему клятвы могут быть опасными? Мы часто используем слова, не осознавая их силу. Иисус предупреждает нас о важности честности и искренности. Клятвы могут создать ложное чувство уверенности, но истина заключается в том, что наши слова должны быть достаточны сами по себе.

en.title: Why Jesus Warns Against Swearing | Jesus Christ
en.description:
Do you really understand the weight of your words? Jesus challenges us to rethink our commitments and the power of our promises. This quote reveals the sacredness of our speech and the seriousness of swearing oaths. In a world where words can be cheap, this reminder calls us to honor our commitments with integrity.

In today's fast-paced society, we often overlook how easily we make promises or use casual language. Jesus emphasizes that our words should be sincere and not tied to grand symbols. Reflecting on this quote can transform how we communicate and build trust with others. 

What does this mean for your daily conversations? Share your thoughts!
